subject: The Good Daughter (Peacock)
query: is the good daughter based on a book
title: Is The Good Daughter based on a book? Yes, Karin Slaughter's novel
answer: Yes. Peacock's "The Good Daughter," premiering Nov. 12, 2026, is adapted from Karin Slaughter's bestselling 2017 novel of the same name. Slaughter wrote all six episodes herself. It is fiction, not a true story, though the story is set in the small town of Pikeville and was filmed in and around Atlanta.
body:
The limited series stars Rose Byrne as Samantha Quinn and Meghann Fahy as Charlotte Quinn, two sisters who have spent 20 years rebuilding lives broken by one night of violence. When another attack hits their town of Pikeville, Charlotte, a lawyer like her father, is the first witness on the scene. Brendan Gleeson plays their father, Rusty Quinn, and Olivia Williams plays their mother, Harriet "Gamma" Quinn.

All six episodes premiere on Peacock on Nov. 12, 2026. Slaughter created the series and made her screenwriting debut on it; Steph Green directed every episode. Other cast members include Harper Steele as Lenore, Michael Dorman as Ben, and Audrey Grace Marshall and Drew Cheek as young Sam and young Charlie.
in_the_news: All six episodes of "The Good Daughter" drop on Peacock on Nov. 12, 2026.

faq.q: Who wrote The Good Daughter book?
